messages:
maya: Heads-up — Diego's onboarding hit two flags: passport expires in ~3 weeks and payroll needs a completed W-8BEN (non-US tax form) before first pay. Day 1 is Fri. Diego, are you able to sign W-8BEN electronically or do you need a notarized copy for your bank?

diego: I can sign the W-8BEN PDF but my bank insists on an apostille for the signature for local compliance. Passport renewal is in progress but not guaranteed before Day 1. I'm in MX (CST).

sarah: For I-9 we still need valid primary ID. If passport will be expired by start, we need an alternate: state ID + copy of birth certificate or national ID with photo. Diego, do you have your national ID?

diego: I have a national voter ID with photo (INE). I can also get a notary-apostille but that might take a few days.

bg-check-bot: Background check: SSN validation skipped (non-US). Criminal screen cleared. Identity verification pending receipt of government ID.

maya: Options: 1) Use national ID + W-8BEN electronically and flag payroll for provisional onboarding (no bank setup until apostille arrives). 2) Arrange embassy/notary apostille and delay laptop/badge ship until docs complete. Which do you prefer?

kevin: From IT side, we can temporarily provision a VPN-only laptop image (no corp creds) and hold device pickup/ship until payroll clears bank setup. If Diego needs immediate access, we can do a remote dev VM.

diego: Prefer to start Day 1 remotely (access only) and finish apostille for bank later. Will that block benefits enrollment?

payroll-bot: Payroll note: Must receive W-8BEN to set tax status. Bank routing requires apostille for direct deposit setup. Benefits enrollment is available on Day 1 but payments won't process until payroll record is complete. You can still enroll.

maya: Great. Action items:
```
- Diego: upload INE (front/back) + signed W-8BEN to secure intake link by Thu 12:00 CST
- Diego: start apostille process and attach receipt in intake (we can accept follow-up apostille within 7 days)
- Payroll: mark as provisional, hold direct deposit until apostille
- IT: prepare VPN-only laptop image and grant Slack + email access; hold shipping until payroll clears
- BG-bot: proceed with identity review on national ID
```

sarah: Diego — please confirm if laptop should ship to your home address once apostille completes or you prefer office pickup when in US for travel. Also confirm signature required.

diego: Ship to home with signature required. If apostille delays >7 days I can pick up at the SF office on next visit.

kevin: Noted. I'll stage the laptop but won't dispatch until payroll gives green. Will send preconfig checklist 24h before ship.

bg-check-bot: ID review started for national ID. Reminder: verification window 72h for uploaded docs.

maya: I'll message hiring manager to confirm manager approval for provisional onboarding (we need a manager sign-off for non-standard ID flow).

payroll-bot: Reminder to Diego: to avoid payment delay, upload W-8BEN and a bank letter (if available) within 5 business days. Otherwise payroll will issue pay via check until direct deposit is set.

diego: Uploaded INE + signed W-8BEN now. Started apostille at local notary today; receipt attached. Thanks everyone.

maya: Received — I'll kick off provisional approvals and track apostille deadline. Welcome aboard and we'll keep you updated in this thread. :party_parrot:
